Hymn 135: My Redeemer Lives
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Lewis D. Edwards
Lyricist/Text Author: Gordon B. Hinckley
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 135 titled "My Redeemer Lives" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Lewis D. Edwards and the lyrics were written by Gordon B. Hinckley.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
